canonicalWiki.rule: exactly one wiki root per project; every CLI / MCP host / worktree must resolve to it

worktreeMapping.rule: every linked worktree resolves to the SAME canonical main-tree wiki root; a per-worktree llmwiki/ copy is never a wiki root and paths under it are uncontained by definition

hardInvariants: containment denials (traversal, symlink escape, uncontained paths) are enforced unconditionally by the resolver; the declarative flags above are records of intent — disabling a flag in this file can never weaken the resolver, and validate rejects any such mutation
identityLabels: structured receipts carry stable labels (<main-working-tree>/<root>) and booleans only; raw host paths are redacted per the house displayPath rule
